evidence.note: Wide lower drawer beside the refrigerator and left of the stove is fully closed.
User's hand is pulling the drawer outward; the contents have become visible.
Drawer is clearly open and remains extended.
User holds the drawer front while pushing it inward.
Drawer is fully closed again.

events.object_description: Wide upper drawer in the lower cabinet between the refrigerator and stove

evidence.note: Both wooden cabinet doors above the range hood are closed.
User reaches to the left door of the cabinet pair.
Left cabinet door is open, exposing the left side of the cabinet interior; the other door remains closed.
Both cabinet doors are still visibly open.
Left door has been swung shut while the right door remains open.

events.object_description: Left wooden door of the cabinet above the range hood

evidence.note: Left cabinet door is open, but the right door is still covering its side of the cabinet.
The right cabinet door has begun swinging outward, revealing more of the interior.
Both cabinet doors are clearly open.
Right cabinet door remains open after the left door has closed.
Both cabinet doors are closed.

events.object_description: Right wooden door of the cabinet above the range hood

evidence.note: Top drawer in the narrow cabinet to the right of the stove is closed.
User grips the top drawer handle to pull it open.
Drawer is open and its utensils, wraps, and cloths are visible.
Drawer remains open immediately before closure.
User is pushing the drawer closed; the drawer front is nearly flush.
Drawer is fully closed again.

events.object_description: Top utensil/storage drawer in the lower cabinet to the right of the stove

notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two doors of the upper cabinet are reported separately because they are manipulated sequentially. Frame estimates represent approximate midpoints of the state-changing actions.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, then opens and closes a wide food-storage drawer, separately opens and closes the two doors of the upper cabinet above the range hood, and finally opens and closes a utensil/storage drawer to the right of the stove.
